messages:
sam: quick heads-upndashuilt a small 'rollout assistant' that suggests fallback policies when you create a rollout. want takes.

lina: short summary?

sam: it ranks 3 options by latency win, cost delta, and a simple quality score. shows soft vs hard degrade, and an estimated impact badge.

noah: how do you measure quality without storing prompts?

sam: small holdout sketching: sample hashes + anonymized diffs. default 5% sampling; enterprise can opt into 100% to secure storage. private deployments default to metadata-only.

priya: must add hysteresis and cooldown by default to avoid flip-flop.

sam: yep. defaults: require 2 consecutive windows OR sustained 90s, cooldown 5m, max 3 auto-switches/hr. editable in UI.

lina: simulation? teams want a what-if on recent traffic.

sam: simulator planned: run policy over a sampled hour and produce counts, p95 delta, and up to 10 sample diffs. attachable to rollout.

noah: API shape: rollout spec gets optional "contingency_policy" which can be inline or ref. controller stores canonicalized copy at creation.

priya: add playbook link generation and auto-incident if triggers exceed threshold. privacy and consent checks required.

sam: noted. I'll add console mocks + proto diff. tagging to review.

ops-bot: FYI: ops data shows model handoff resolved 80% of recent p90 spikes within 2m.

sam: thanks will incorporate region-specific defaults.

lina: looks good. keep defaults conservative for beta.
